summary: Load-time binary dropper fetches and executes remote payload from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: On require(), index.js loads _bridge.js which assembles obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hostnames from split string literals (oob-worker.cf100-416.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev) and downloads a platform-specific opaque binary via https.get. If HTTPS fails, a DNS-TXT covert-channel fallback queries c.<domain> for a chunk count then <i>.<domain> TXT records under tin.dl.well1.site, tina.dl.well1.site, ldr.dl.well1.site, and win.dl.well1.site, base64-decoding the concatenated chunks. The bytes are written to a hidden path in /tmp or %TEMP%, chmodded 0755, and executed detached via spawn("/bin/sh", ["-c", fp+" &"]) or spawn("cmd",...). Cover strings such as "analytics_state" and "dotnet_diag" mask the behavior. The hosts are unrelated to any declared publisher, the fetched content is opaque and unverified, and execution fires automatically when any consumer imports the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
